purpose: Resolve the Ica-versus-Arequipa Río Seco homonym using official ANA evidence while keeping geometry, outlets, thresholds, capacity and event footprints fail-closed.

sources.forbidden_use: Classification establishes watercourse identity and parent-UH context only; it is not activation evidence, local event geometry, outlet, discharge, capacity or threshold evidence.

sources.forbidden_use: Historical narrative does not define exact event footprint, event timing, discharge, local outlet geometry, capacity or transferable threshold.

sources.title: R.D. N° 0130-2025-ANA-AAA.CO — faja marginal del cauce de la quebrada Río Seco, UH 13254

homonym_guard.rule: Never merge, transfer events, reuse geometry or infer outlets by name. Any geometry acceptance must independently match the expected parent hydrographic unit.
